description: Read an evaluation job by its job_id. While the job runs this gives the status (QUEUED or RUNNING) and the progress. When the job fails it gives the error. When the job completes it gives the aggregated report: the summary text, the average conversation and turn scores, the highlights and the top failure categories. There is no separate summary call: a completed job already carries that report. For the per-conversation transcripts and per-turn labels, take the ids from `eval_ids_by_score` and call mba_get_eval_details. This tool adds a `details` key when it can read those ids for you.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_eval_results
title: Read evaluation results
